question: Was the earlier WATER->HARVEST gain supported by skipping WATER, by HARVEST itself, or both?
confirmed: Skipping the step250 WATER alone changes terminal_self and improves 7/10 in this fixed10.
Among the eight cases where HARVEST beat WATER, HARVEST also beat PASS in only four cases.
In seeds 92802002, 92802004, 92802005, and 92802008, PASS beat HARVEST even though HARVEST beat WATER.
In seeds 92802006, 92802007, 92802009, and 92802010, HARVEST beat both WATER and PASS.
In the two HARVEST-vs-WATER worsening cases, seeds 92802001 and 92802003, PASS still beat WATER while HARVEST was much worse than PASS.
boundary: PASS is itself a world-changing intervention.
HARVEST-PASS is not a pure crop-value estimate because downstream actions and World divergence remain included.
The result weakens the interpretation that the earlier 8/10 gain was simply due to harvesting mature output.
No state-based decision rule is promoted yet.
